Its artifact_hashes omit both the candidate file SHA-256 c8eaff58ac936e9ed4ed3232976eb70d5b2c6a6bcca03597ad8cc7bd6901d6f9 and candidate_hash 629bf30a38d13108d65fc5eaa4c129963628661da2162f8c45bb30c6e7829481, even though the request names candidate.json as an input and the observed result claims to validate candidate top/core. The closure is also timestamped 03:30 and the preconditions 04:00, both before the candidate. Bundle path hashes bind the files at audit transport time but do not establish what the earlier test consumed. Therefore the claimed 16/16 closure is not replayable evidence for this candidate and cannot support positive authorization.
